userRequest: 开整：先做比基线稍大的共享计算模型

architecture.policy: Original 32 gates + 10 D4 positional biases; one projection per pattern reused by legal squares

speedGate.identityProbe: Frozen v1.37 table/trunk/head plus zero residual output, identical complete predictions and trees
speedGate.selection: Prefer width16 if passes, otherwise width8 if passes; do not train if neither passes
speedGate.comparison: Interleaved same-root 131072-simulation cold searches, 8 roots x 3 rounds; actual legal policy kernel, 128 validation boards per phase x 9 rounds

training.loss: outcome MSE + 0.1 WDL CE + 0.1 legal-next-move CE
training.initialization: Random shared parameters identical to original v1.37 initialization; residual down random; up weights/bias zero. No trained baseline warm start
training.selection: Minimum original validation outcome MSE; candidate test only after model selected and frozen

matches.plan: After training and export correctness, one 100ms/20 paired-color screening comparison against frozen v1.37; no book; no automatic promotion
matches.policy: learned PUCT 1.5; finite FPU parent mean minus0.15; v1.3 openings

isolation: All candidate C++ format/kernel support is built from an isolated .build source snapshot; default cpp, selector, model and browser assets are not rewritten
limits: Single training seed and a small paired screening match; offline/throughput results are not strength claims; native platform timing only
